name: openspec_tasks_to_subtasks
description: Parse OpenSpec tasks.md into plan-only subtasks ({id, description, files}). Cross-task safety is enforced by the shared plan validator; testing is separate.

useOpenSpec.description: When present and falsy, skip parsing tasks.md entirely and pass fallbackSubtasks through the shared plan validator instead (generic document plan).

fallbackSubtasks.description: Pre-built subtasks[] plan to validate and return as-is when useOpenSpec is falsy. Defaults to an empty array.

tasksPath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSpec change's tasks.md file to parse. Required unless useOpenSpec is falsy.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo, used to validate each subtask's files as safe, existing, non-directory, repository-relative paths.

subtasks.description: Normalized, validated plan groups: each has an id, description, and a file-disjoint, non-empty files[] list.

files.description: Exact repository-relative files exclusively owned by this group.

reparsed.description: True when subtasks were freshly parsed from tasks.md; false when fallbackSubtasks were used unchanged (useOpenSpec falsy).
